# Toolioz — Comprehensive Machine-Readable Knowledge Base

> Privacy-first client-side web utility platform. All operations execute strictly inside browser memory using Web Workers, HTML5 Canvas 2D, and WebAssembly. No server storage or file transmission occurs during tool execution.

## Architecture & Privacy Model
- **Zero Server Uploads**: PDF manipulation (splitting, merging, blank page removal, bookmarks, grayscale, booklet generation) is handled entirely by client-side JavaScript (`pdf-lib` and `pdfjs-dist`).
- **Data Privacy**: Cryptographic hashing (BCrypt, SHA, MD5), data transformation (CSV, JSON, KML, GPX, XML, TypeScript), and JWT decoding never send user inputs to external endpoints.
- **Formula Accuracy**: Mathematical calculations (SIP, Compound Interest, Loan Prepayment) implement standard financial engineering formulas without server roundtrips.

---

### Remove Blank Pages
- **Canonical URL**: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/remove-blank-pages
- **Markdown Endpoint**: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/remove-blank-pages.md
- **Category**: pdftools
- **Description**: Detects and removes empty or blank pages from a PDF with an adjustable sensitivity slider. Processed 100% in your browser.
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side In-Browser

**Usage Steps**:
1. Choose a PDF file.
2. Set the blank sensitivity slider (default 99.5% white).
3. Process and download the document with empty pages removed.

**Practical Example**: Automatically strip blank separator sheets from scanned contracts or multi-page invoices.

**Constraints / Limitations**: Very light watermarks or scanned page shadows may require lowering the sensitivity threshold to be detected as blank.

---

### Letter ↔ A4
- **Canonical URL**: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/letter-to-a4
- **Markdown Endpoint**: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/letter-to-a4.md
- **Category**: pdftools
- **Description**: Resize PDF pages between US Letter and ISO A4 dimensions with proportional scaling. The file is not uploaded.
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side In-Browser

**Usage Steps**:
1. Choose a PDF file.
2. Select the conversion direction (Letter to A4 or A4 to Letter).
3. Download the resized PDF with balanced margins.

**Practical Example**: Convert US Letter specifications to standard international A4 format before sharing with overseas colleagues.

**Constraints / Limitations**: Pages are scaled proportionally without distortion. Small margin width adjustments may occur.

### 2 Pages Per Sheet
- **Canonical URL**: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/2-pages-per-sheet
- **Markdown Endpoint**: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/2-pages-per-sheet.md
- **Category**: pdftools
- **Description**: Combines two PDF pages side-by-side onto a single sheet for compact reading and booklet printing.
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side In-Browser

**Usage Steps**:
1. Choose a PDF document.
2. Click Process to place two pages side-by-side per landscape sheet.
3. Download the N-up booklet PDF.

**Practical Example**: Print a 30-page slide deck on 15 sheets of paper to cut paper consumption in half.

**Constraints / Limitations**: Pages are scaled down proportionally to fit side-by-side. Very small footnotes may be harder to read.
